title: UDP Receive
text: Receive data over UDP network from specified remote machine, 2 outputs, {Terminator} sets Terminator; {Local address} sets the local host name or IP, {Local port} sets the port of local host for binding, {Enable local port sharing} allows other UDP sockets to bind to same local, {Remote address} sets the remote host name, {Remote port} sets the remote host port, {Verify address and port connectivity} sets the remote machine connection verification, {Output latest data} sets the receive latest data, {Data size} sets the number of values read, {Source Data type} sets the output data type, {ASCII format string} sets the format of string, {Custom Terminator} sets the custom terminator numeric array, {Byte order} sets the sequential order, {Enable blocking mode} sets the simulation waits while receiving data, {Timeout} sets the allowed time to complete operations and {Block sample time} sets the sampling time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Local address
params.values: Local host name or IP address 0.0.0.0 (default) | local host name or IP address

params.name: Local port
params.values: Port of local host for binding -1 (default) | local host port

params.name: Enable local port sharing
params.values: Allow other UDP sockets to bind to same local port off (default) | on

params.name: Remote address
params.values: Remote host name or address localhost (default) | remote host name or IP address

params.name: Remote port
params.values: Remote host port 9090 (default) | remote host port

params.name: Data size
params.values: Number of values read [1, 1] (default) | numeric array

params.name: Source Data type
params.values: Output data type uint8 (default) | single | double | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | ASCII

params.name: ASCII format string
params.values: Format of string data %f (default) | numeric conversion specifiers

params.name: Terminator
params.values: Terminator LF (default) | CR | CR/LF | LF/CR | Custom terminator

params.name: Custom Terminator
params.values: Custom terminator numeric array | integer from 0 to 255

params.name: Byte order
params.values: Sequential order of bytes big-endian (default) | little-endian

params.name: Enable blocking mode
params.values: Simulation waits while receiving data on (default) | off

params.name: Timeout
params.values: Allowed time to complete operations 10 (default) | positive scalar
